# Steam Store

> > Digital distribution platform for PC gaming, offering game purchases, downloads, and account management through Valve Corporation's Steam service.

Steam Store is the primary storefront for the Steam platform, featuring thousands of games including Detroit: Become Human, Warframe, Dying Light, and Warhammer 40,000 titles. The store includes age verification systems, account authentication, and comprehensive game discovery features.

- Steam platform
- Valve Corporation
- Age verification
- Game store

- PC gaming

- [Warframe on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/230410/): Age check page for Warframe game on Steam platform
- [Warhammer® 40,000: Dawn of War® II Chaos Rising on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/20570/): Age verification for Warhammer 40K: Dawn of War II Chaos Rising
- [The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/939850/): Age verification for The Dark Pictures Anthology: Man of Medan

## Account Management

- [Email Verification](https://store.steampowered.com/account/newaccountverification): Email verification page for new Steam account authentication
